items.title: Leslie Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: Reginald Robinson — are you familiar with Reggie? ... He is a young black man who heard Scott Joplin recordings. ... Reginald was 13 years old, a Chicago guy.

ctx.x: Why don’t you see — there’s very few black musicians who seem to play in early jazz bands, in traditional jazz bands, at least in my experience.
That’s true. In ragtime there’s a fellow who got a MacArthur grant, Reginald Robinson — are you familiar with Reggie?
